_comment: Written by hand. What ssh's stderr becomes as the cause the refusal of every key keeps (Go sdk/bootstrap diagText, Rust shed-source bootstrap::diag_text), read by the Go test TestNoSSHIdentitiesCauseSharedTable (sdk/bootstrap) and the Rust test no_ssh_identities_cause_shared_table (crates/shed-source/src/bootstrap.rs), so the two cannot drift. Each case: `stderr` is ssh's stderr and `cause` the text the error carries after the hint. When `pad` is set, that many 'a' characters are put before both `stderr` and `cause`, to place a character at the 2048-byte clip boundary. The rule: trim surrounding white space; cut at 2048 bytes on a character boundary; printable ASCII other than backslash is itself; backslash, line feed, carriage return and tab are written \\, \n, \r, \t; every other character is \u{<lowercase hex>}; a cut text ends with …(truncated).

cases.stderr: No more authentication methods to try.
